messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SENTRY INGEST — spike in 5xx responses from external Sentry vendor (ingest API). Observability alerts triggered at 2026-03-15T09:11:36Z. Possible missing exception events. Paging devon (oncall) and sre_lead_jordan.

devon: acknowledging, looking now. seeing a clear drop in received events on our Sentry dashboard (events/sec down ~22%) and backend responses from sentry.ingest.redwood-vendor.com are 502/503.

carmen: support getting customer reports about delayed error groups, some teams saying errors never showed up in Sentry. capture ticket numbers IPR-879 / CUST-2210. tagging for impact assessment.

devon: quick checks:
```
# curl to vendor endpoint from our collector host
curl -i -s -X POST https://sentry.ingest.redwood-vendor.com/api/ingest -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"event":"test"}'
# response: 502 Bad Gateway, upstream read timeout
```

devon: I've toggled verbose logging on our ingest proxies to capture payloads, and started a temporary local-forward to our internal event-fallback sink to confirm we can capture dropped events server-side. not yet enabling globally.

alice: from infra — vendor status page shows degraded service starting ~09:05 UTC. link: https://status.sentry-vendor.example/incidents/3456 (vendor page updated). they list auth-proxy 502s from a downstream provider.

ben: sentry vendor suggests they are throttling due to auth provider returning 502s; they recommend retry/backoff client-side and filing a support ticket for priority. I'm composing the ticket now (TICKET-REDWOOD-1121).

carmen: customer-impact note (draft):
- impact window: ~09:05 — ongoing (monitoring) UTC
- symptom: some exception events not indexed in Sentry / delayed grouping
- affected regions: us-east-1 (primary); partial in eu-west-1
- estimated % of events dropped: ~15–25% (prelim)
- workaround: enable internal event-fallback or switch to logging-only for critical services
please add any owner comments, will publish to status.redwood.example once confirmed.

devon: mitigation plan executed so far:
1) Increased collector retry/backoff to 6 retries with exponential backoff for 30m window (see runbook step 2).
2) Enabled verbose ingest proxy logs and started copying failed payloads to internal fallback queue (events-fallback).
3) Notifying customers with active incident tickets (carmen).
4) Opening vendor escalation (ben) and attaching sample payloads + timestamps.

sre_lead_jordan: good. if vendor doesn't confirm mitigation in 30m escalate to on-call escalation policy (pager duty to sec-eng). prepare runbook link: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/sentry-ingest-degradation

devon: attempting a controlled global toggle for fallback for low-risk services to reduce customer blind spots. command: 
```
# toggle feature flag for fallback
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \ 
  https://console.internal/api/flags/events_fallback/toggle -d '{"state":"on","scope":"low-risk"}'
```

support-lead-meera: please hold on mass toggles — need to coordinate with billing and product (we don't want duplicate events counted). Carmen can draft guidance for customers on how to interpret duplicate events if fallback introduced.

devon: noted — will limit fallback to non-billing-critical projects and tag events with `sourcemap:fallback` to avoid double-count.

ben: vendor ticket created TICKET-REDWOOD-1121, included payloads and trace IDs. vendor responded: "We are investigating, root cause appears to be third-party auth provider failure causing our proxy 502s." They assigned severity P1 and said will update ETA in 15m.

carmen: I've published an internal incident note to #customer-updates and drafted a short external status line: "We're seeing delays and potential missing error events in Sentry. We're investigating with the vendor and have enabled temporary fallbacks for some services." waiting on %impact to publish public status.

devon: check-in — ingestion error rate stabilized a bit (from 22% drop to 9% drop) after vendor started limited mitigation at 09:28 UTC. still seeing sporadic 502s on specific auth tokens.

sre_lead_jordan: plan for handoff — devon you'll continue oncall until 09:40 UTC and then handoff to ben. Please document exact time ranges for which we may have missing events and include the list of affected orgs. Ben, be prepared to contact vendor engineers if P1 not resolved.

devon: confirmed handoff schedule. adding quick checklist to thread for ben:
- confirm vendor ETA and capture final incident id on vendor status page
- verify internal fallback queue has captured failed payloads (sampling)
- coordinate with Carmen on final customer communications
- if vendor not resolved by 10:00 UTC, escalate per policy (runbook step 5)

ben: acknowledged, I'll take the 09:40 handoff and keep watch on the vendor ticket. preparing short postmortem placeholder.

support-lead-meera: prepping customer churn risk list — will prioritize outreach to 3 enterprise customers that reported missing error groups.

devon: leaving detailed logs and snippets in the incident tracker (INC-2026-0315-SENTRY) and adding the list of sample event IDs that failed to ingest. handoff in 5m. :eyes:

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Handoff recorded. next oncall: ben. Thread will remain open for updates.
